premises.text: Typical search stacks separate database, search index, and web server so index changes require updates in three places—search is too hard to implement
premises.evidence_span: every time we wanted to modify the index, we had to change the system in three separate places

premises.text: ThriftDB combines database, search index, and web server into one on-demand cloud database with search built in
premises.evidence_span: ThriftDB is just combining the database, the search index, and the web server into one system

premises.text: Companies model data as objects with attributes; ThriftDB handles objects natively—put objects in, get objects back, search across them
premises.evidence_span: we designed ThriftDB to handle objects natively. With ThriftDB, you put in objects, you get objects back, you search across them

premises.text: Delivers fast scalable attribute-aware search (filters, facets, schema upload without downtime) proven on HN, TechCrunch, and Octopart-scale catalogs
premises.evidence_span: With ThriftDB, you get fast, scalable search right out of the box

value.text: Make powerful search extremely simple to implement
value.evidence_span: It's a really powerful tool that's also extremely simple to use
